data.one_liner: A Dart/Flutter test runner that streams TestEvent objects from dart test or flutter test.
data.what_it_does: It launches a dart test or flutter test process and emits a stream of TestEvent instances that describe test progress, results, and process exit. The events can be consumed by custom tooling or dashboards.
use_when: building custom test tooling that needs real-time test events
integrating test output into CI dashboards
generating coverage reports from test streams
avoid_when: running tests from the command line without needing a stream
using a standard test runner like flutter test directly
strengths: Provides a clean stream of structured test events
Supports both Dart and Flutter test commands
Handles stdout/stderr chunks and drains streams on exit
weaknesses: Only useful for tooling that consumes TestEvent streams
No built‑in UI or reporting features

alternatives.name: test_api
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers lower‑level access to test events and can be used directly in custom test runners
